summary: AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric utility, filed a Form 6-K announcing revised deadlines for its ongoing redemption or conversion program of Class C preferred shares (PNC). Following the first completed transaction on June 9 and 14, 2026, the company reduced the delivery period for converted common shares to 9 trading sessions and the redemption payment period to 13 trading sessions, replacing the prior 12 and 16 business-day periods. Shareholders may elect 1:1 conversion into common shares, otherwise shares are automatically redeemed at the closing price of common shares on the session before the Board resolution. Non-resident investors and ADR holders are subject to specific rules, including mandatory redemption for ADR-backed PNC shares. The program effectively returns capital to preferred shareholders, and the shortened timelines enhance efficiency. Watch for future redemption announcements and potential price arbitrage between PNC shares and common shares.
